plug-straight-in:
"Every week someone asks me: can I just connect Claude or ChatGPT to my SQL Account? You can. There are 3 ways, so let's compare them honestly.

Way 1: do it yourself. A programmer wires Claude straight into the database. It only works when you ask it. It writes straight into the tables and skips SQL Account's own checks, there is no approval and no log, and it lives on a programmer's laptop. You pay the programmer and the AI subscription.

Way 2: a connector. A plug-in that lets Claude or ChatGPT talk to SQL Account. This is a proper product: it uses SQL Account's own login, and you approve orders. But it still only works when someone asks it something. It covers accounting only, and it runs on 1 office PC that must stay switched on. And you pay twice: the connector fee, plus a Claude or ChatGPT subscription for every user.

Way 3: SuDu AI. AI staff that work on their own every day: chasing payments, sending reports, taking orders. It keeps SQL Account's rules, everything waits in an approval queue and is logged. It covers accounting, warehouse and factory. It runs in the cloud, on web, mobile and WhatsApp. And it is 1 price, with the AI included.

Claude and ChatGPT are great brains. With SuDu you get the brain, the ERP and the AI staff, all in 1 price."

Note: keep it fair: do not name any connector product. Claude is made by Anthropic, ChatGPT by OpenAI.
Next: "Let me go 1 level deeper."
plug-deep:
"Let me go 1 level deeper, because this is where the difference really shows. A connector lets you chat with your data. SuDu runs your company. 4 things.

WhatsApp. A connector drafts orders from chats you forward to it. SuDu has a contact book that links every WhatsApp number to its customer or supplier, so it reads new chats, POs and bank slips by itself: nobody has to forward anything.

Memory. A chat app remembers only this chat; close it and it forgets. SuDu has a memory layer: every customer's history, habits like Milo means the 1 kg pack, and past chats, across millions of records.

Long tasks. A chat is 1 question, 1 answer. SuDu runs tasks that last for days: send the reminder, wait for the reply, follow up on Friday, close the case when the money is in.

Big reports. This one matters for your server. SQL Account runs on a Firebird database. It is built for daily bookkeeping, not for an AI scanning years of data. If every AI question goes straight to it, a big report can slow it down for the whole office, while your staff are trying to issue invoices. SuDu is moving those big questions onto its own data platform, so your SQL Account server stays fast for your staff."

Note: the data platform is rolling out; say "is moving", not "already". Keep it fair: no connector product is named.
